title: StreamMax Update v1.0.4 🚀
changelog: Smart initial auto-switch: App automatically probes & finds an active mirror on first tap without manual clicking
Playback lock: Video stream stays locked to current server during slow network buffering (no unexpected jumping)
100% Ad-Free clean streaming: Permanent clickjacking interceptor, popup blocker & zero ads
Added 🇵🇰 Pakistani Drama Serials section with native Urdu original audio (hides English/Hindi toggles)
Money Heist exclusive dual audio preference selector (English & Hindi Dubbed)
Fixed video player orientation & smooth single-tap minimize back to portrait
Android 12+ sleek dark cinema splash screen with official StreamMax branding
Real direct MP4 offline downloads via dual-audio resolvers
Hardware volume button sync: Physical phone volume keys & right-side vertical swipe now directly control real mobile media volume
Movie-only screen brightness: Left-side swipe controls video display brightness without affecting device system brightness
